lines.text: A ratified covenant cannot be canceled, and the promises to Abraham and his seed meant One, who is Christ.
The law came 430 years later, and God freely granted Abraham the inheritance through the law.
We were held in custody under the law, which became our guardian to lead us to Christ.
You are all sons of God through faith, with neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female.
God sent Moses, born of a woman and under the law, to redeem those under the law.
